_comment: Flat content blob (no route/page) for the shared TourRequirements component, rendered inline on tour package detail pages (/tours/from-bali/[slug], /tours/from-surabaya/[slug]) whenever pkg.route includes "Ijen Crater". Read directly via src/lib/ecosystemContent/ijenCraterRequirements.ts — same local-read + HTTP-fallback convention as review-platforms.json / trust-claims.json in this directory. This was the last 100%-hardcoded editorial fragment in jvto-web with no prior live source; content below was copied verbatim from src/components/website/TourRequirements.tsx during migration (2026-08-19) and has no separate historical source-of-truth to cross-check against. | 2026-08-21: added pageContent.authoritySource — the Ministry of Forestry portal that actually states the health-certificate rule, including the 3-day validity window the site had never published, and the current ticket URL. The previously cited tiket.bbksdajatim.org is dead.

pageContent.heading: Mandatory Requirements: Ijen Crater Tour
pageContent.intro: To ensure safety and compliance with the access rules published by the Ministry of Forestry for TWA Kawah Ijen, please review the requirements below.

requirementsTable.note: Must state "Fit for hiking/physical activity" and be issued no more than 3 days before the visit date. Provided by JVTO.
Provided by JVTO. Mandatory for sulfur fume protection.
Strict regulation. ID card required for verification.
To reach the summit before sunrise. Blue Fire visibility is subject to authority access policies and natural conditions, including sulfur gas levels and weather, and cannot be guaranteed.

pageContent.faqHeading: Frequently Asked Questions about Ijen Requirements

faqItems.question: Do I really need a health certificate for Ijen?

answerSegments.text: . You cannot purchase an entrance ticket without showing a valid health certificate obtained from a clinic or hospital on the
are strictly prohibited by BKSDA regulations due to safety concerns, especially related to sulfur gas exposure.

authoritySource.name: Ayo ke Taman Nasional — TWA Kawah Ijen (Ministry of Forestry)
statedRequirements: Visitors must be in good physical and mental condition.
Visitors are required to bring and show a valid health certificate issued no more than 3 days before the visit date.
Visitors with a history of heart disease, asthma, respiratory infections, or breathing disorders are not recommended to hike.
Please ensure booking data matches official identification documents (ID Card/Passport).
Visitors are required to use personal safety equipment such as anti-slip shoes, warm jackets, and masks.
authoritySource.ticketPolicy: Purchased tickets are non-cancelable, non-reschedulable, and non-refundable under any circumstances.
authoritySource.note: Quoted verbatim from the official portal's Hiking Requirements and Ticket Policy panels. This is the authority for the health-certificate requirement: SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 reopens the crater and names 'protokol kesehatan yang berlaku' but does not state the certificate rule itself. Supersedes tiket.bbksdajatim.org, which no longer resolves.
